parent.title: A Vienna weekend, built around the Michelin reservation

siblings.title: Things to do in Vienna
siblings.summary: Schönbrunn morning + Belvedere afternoon on one day, Stephansdom + Hofburg + a real coffee house on the other.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Vienna
siblings.summary: Six restaurants carry 2+ Michelin stars in Vienna for 2026 — pick by cuisine, room and budget.

sources.title: Google Cloud Meetup Vienna
sources.claim: Google Cloud Meetup Vienna #36 on Thu May 28 2026 at weXelerate, two talks (long-term memory for AI agents; supply-chain attack anatomy), check-in 17:30.

sources.title: RubyConf Austria
sources.claim: RubyConf Austria 2026 runs May 29-31 in Vienna with the main conference day at Das MuTh, plus a Vienna.rb meetup and a hike.

sources.title: 10times — RubyConf Austria
sources.claim: RubyConf Austria 2026 venue is Das MuTh, Am Augartenspitz 1, 1020 Vienna; main talks Saturday May 30.

sources.title: OWASP Global AppSec EU 2026
sources.claim: OWASP Global AppSec EU 2026 runs Jun 22-26 at Austria Center Vienna: training Jun 22-24, conference Jun 25-26.

sources.title: dev.events Vienna tech
sources.claim: Dev.events lists Vienna 2026 tech conferences including RubyConf Austria, OWASP Global AppSec EU, ThreatModCon, uxcon, Future Builders, Cloud Native Days.

sources.title: ThreatModCon
sources.claim: ThreatModCon 2026 Vienna, the only conference dedicated to threat modeling, runs Jun 26-27 at Meliá Vienna.

sources.title: Eventbrite — ThreatModCon 2026 Vienna
sources.claim: ThreatModCon 2026 Vienna tickets confirm dates Fri Jun 26 – Sat Jun 27 2026.

sources.title: Microsoft techConference
sources.claim: Microsoft techConference 2026 (#TC26) takes place Jun 9-10 2026 at Messe Wien — Microsoft-ecosystem focus on AI, security, cloud, quantum.

sources.title: CANCOM — techConference 2026
sources.claim: techConference 2026 takes place June 9-10 2026 at Messe Wien Exhibition Congress Centre, with topics spanning AI Business Solutions, Security, Cloud & AI Platforms, Sovereignty, Quantum.

sources.title: uxcon vienna
sources.claim: uxcon vienna 2026 runs Sep 16-17 at the University of Vienna; 600 UXers from 43 countries, followed by Future Builders (Sep 18) for senior practitioners.

sources.title: Cloud Native Days Austria
sources.claim: Cloud Native Days Austria 2026 runs Sep 29-30 at Cineplexx Wienerberg; fourth edition, formerly KCD Austria.

sources.title: AAIC — Applied AI Conference
sources.claim: AAIC – Applied AI Conference 2026 is on Sep 24 at WKÖ (Wiedner Hauptstrasse 63, 1045 Vienna); Austria's premier AI business symposium initiated by AI Austria.

sources.title: TEDAI Vienna
sources.claim: TEDAI Vienna 2026 runs Oct 28-30 at the Hofburg with 1,100+ guests from 65+ countries and 820+ organizations.

sources.title: TEDAI Vienna program
sources.claim: TEDAI Vienna 2026 features 20+ TED Talks across two conference days plus opening gala; speakers include Geoffrey Hinton and Nicholas Thompson.

sources.title: Trending Topics — Peter Steinberger at TEDAI 2026
sources.claim: TEDAI 2026 speaker lineup also includes Peter Steinberger (OpenClaw creator) alongside Geoffrey Hinton.

sources.title: Future Forward
sources.claim: Future Forward 2026 is Nov 26 at weXelerate Innovation Hub — 1,000+ attendees, 50+ speakers, 42 nations represented.

sources.title: WeAreDevelopers World Congress
sources.claim: WeAreDevelopers World Congress 2026 is in Berlin (Jul 8-10), not Vienna — 15,000+ attendees, 500+ speakers across 20+ stages.

sources.title: ViennaJS
sources.claim: ViennaJS is Austria's largest JavaScript community; meets every last Wednesday of the month, short talks in English, rotating venues.

sources.title: AI Austria — event calendar
sources.claim: AI Austria runs a busy 2026 calendar in Vienna including ESSAI European Summer School on AI (Jun 29), monthly GenAI sessions, Vibecoding launch (Jun 8).

sources.title: AI Austria — monthly update
sources.claim: AI Austria's GenAI Community sessions feature talks from EnliteAI, Felix Krause (hackathon lessons), and Daniel Noszian on Austria's agentic AI scene.

sources.title: Vienna DevOps & Security Meetup
sources.claim: Vienna DevOps & Security Meetup meets at ÖBB Open Innovation Factory, Lassallestraße 5, 1020 Wien.

sources.title: Cloud Native Computing Vienna
sources.claim: Cloud Native Computing Vienna covers cloud-native development from DevOps, dev, and ops perspectives.

sources.title: PyData Vienna
sources.claim: PyData Vienna is a group for users and developers of data-analysis tools (Python, R, Julia).

sources.title: Vienna Data and AI Meetup
sources.claim: Vienna Data and AI Meetup is sponsored by Accenture; community focused on Data Science/Engineering, ML, and AI.

sources.title: Vienna AI Engineering
sources.claim: Vienna AI Engineering (formerly Vienna Data Science Tools / Vienna Spark) was founded 2015, revived post-pandemic with a focus on AI engineering.

sources.title: WeAreDevelopers — Vienna meetups
sources.claim: WeAreDevelopers lists 7 notable Vienna meetups including Vienna Deep Learning, PyLadies Vienna, React Vienna, Vue.js Vienna, Vienna Data Engineering, Unity 3D.

sources.title: weXelerate
sources.claim: weXelerate is a 9,000m² innovation hub at Praterstraße 1, 1020 Wien (Jean Nouvel building), hosting accelerator, coworking, and frequent meetups.

sources.title: Visiting Vienna — 4GAMECHANGERS
sources.claim: 4GAMECHANGERS Festival (ProSiebenSat.1 PULS 4) is taking a creative break — 2026 dates TBA.
